page.layout: Top: page number "I" centred; a decorative woodcut band. Then the title block, centred: "PRODIDAGMA / LAMPADIS / PHILOSOPHICÆ". Below it one column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. The bottom of the page has the gathering signature "A" centred.

main_text.l: Scriptores in qualibet facultate sunt vel theori-

l.i: ci, vel practici.
Theorici sunt, qui rerum naturas certis præce-
ptionibus comprehendunt & veluti penicillo quodam
depingunt. Et hi in quatuor classes sunt divisi. Alii
namq; sunt Didactici, qui per locos communes
κατασκευαστικῶς docent. Alii Polemici, qui ἀνασκευαστικῶς
sua themata & problemata pertractant κατὰ
θέσιν ἢ ἄρσιν sive ἀντίθεσιν [?]. Alii Analytici, qui
& Exegetici sive Textuales, qui aliorum scripta re-
texunt, quod Græcis est βιβλία ὀρθοτομεῖν. Alii deniq;
Methodici, qui in hoc toti sunt, ut ea, quæ ab ali-
is sunt inventa, & vel confusè, vel ordine negligen-
tiusculo tradita, redigant in aliquem, si nullus sit, vel
meliorem, si negligens sit, ordinem.
Practici (latè sumto vocabulo) sunt, qui præce-
ptorum traditorum in vitâ humanâ usum ritè osten-
dunt.
Hi omnes & singuli magnam sanè merentur lau-
dem, bene etiam de proximo merentur; maximè
tamen Methodici & Practici. Quæ causa & me impu-
lit, ut me conferrem in ordinem Methodicorum &
Practicorum. Abfit arrogantia dicto, abfit invidia ver-
bo. Ego enim in horum talium, quos dixi, scriptorum
choro infimas me tenere propalàm lubens profiteor.
Quamvis autem multorum sinistra judicia hactenus

page.notes: Page number "I" and the signature "A" as printed. The marginal note "Scriptores Methodici & Practici præ cæteris excellunt." is set in two lines beside the paragraph; the second line has been transcribed as printed. Greek "ἀντίθεσιν" is hard to read on the scan and is marked [?]. The printed hyphen in "theori-ci", "osten-dunt" and "re-texunt" is kept at line ends. The printed "ritè" and "Quamvis" are transcribed as shown. The Greek words at line ends ("κατασκευαστικῶς", "ἀνασκευαστικῶς") are transcribed as they appear on the scan.
